messages:
alex: Quick alert — FRA inbound container flagged, forwarder reports customs photo inspection delaying sea top-up ~12 days. 40 units total, 6 DOA. Need routing, RMA serials, and pre-credit terms.
vendor-liaison: Logged RMA 2026-910. DOA serials in ticket. We can split: offer 24 air replacements (premium +$950/unit) and 10 sea. AMS diversion possible for up to 12 units (adds ~2 days).
tia: Paste DOA serials here so depot can start intake and photos.
vendor-liaison: DOA SNs: SN-K1L2M3N4, SN-K1L2M3N5, SN-K1L2M3N6, SN-K1L2M3N7, SN-K1L2M3N8, SN-K1L2M3N9.
vendor-liaison: HS 8471.50.80, invoice amended and refiled 15m ago. Forwarder confirms amendment received but photo inspection still booked.
sam: Ops prefer air fill for 16 live nodes + replacements. Proposal: 18 air to FRA, 6 divert to AMS, sea for rest. Cost check: 24 air * $950 = $22,800. Vendor suggests 88% pre-credit on DOAs; can increase to 93% if Redwood takes AWB expedite. Billing ref needed.
vendor-liaison: We accept 93% pre-credit if AWB charged to REF: RDW-PO-4733. SLA: "Dispatch up to 24 air replacements within 48h of pre-credit; 93% pre-credit on listed DOAs on pre-authorization; remaining 7% after depot photo verification; AWB invoiced to RDW-PO-4733." 
rma-bot: RMA 2026-910 created. Status: pending-photos. Upload depot photos within 72h to avoid holdback.
tia: Ops will upload photos. I'll attach HS code and amended invoice to RMA and loop in customs liaison.
alex: Approve 93% pre-credit + AWB. Confirm diversion: 6 to AMS, 18 to FRA by air, remainder by sea. Alex will coordinate photo uploads and update ticket 2026-910.
sam: Finance, please standby to process pre-credit once SLA + billing ref are in vendor invoice. I'll log the expedite cost to this month's ops budget.
vendor-liaison: Confirmed. We'll push SLA and invoice refs into the RMA now. Thanks.
